response.summary: Data Quality rejects the sealed retrospective 2026-09-22 review bundle. The completed price session is supported: the manifest and execution archive align the watchlist plus benchmark to 2026-09-21 with audited unadjusted closing bars. Source integrity also passes: bundle and generation hashes validate under the project hash conventions, inlined file SHA-256 values match their text, generation input hashes match, and the execution archive validates. The blocker is coverage quality: the non-price sentiment breadth evidence is internally invalid, with up_gt5, up, down, down_gt5, and flat all equal to 5560, so broad-market sentiment coverage is not semantically supportable even though the file is present. This review only assesses the sealed retrospective data package and does not certify timely premarket publication, Paper execution, or chain completion.
